session_id.Description: A session identifier of the form ses-<label>, indicating the recording session (NWB file) for this cell in the dataset.

dissociated_cell_sample_nhash_id.Description: Identifier (NHash ID) at NIMP Analytics (https://brain-specimenportal.org/nimp_analytics) of the Dissociated Cell Sample profiled in this session.

dissociated_cell_sample_local_name.Description: Human-readable local name of the Dissociated Cell Sample at NIMP Analytics.

tissue_sample_brain_structure_id_homba.Description: HOMBA ontology identifier for the brain structure from which the tissue sample was taken.

tissue_sample_brain_structure_name_homba.Description: HOMBA ontology name for the brain structure from which the tissue sample was taken.

tissue_sample_brain_structure_id_ccf.Description: Allen Common Coordinate Framework (CCF-2020) ontology identifier for the brain structure from which the tissue sample was taken.

tissue_sample_brain_structure_name_ccf.Description: Allen Common Coordinate Framework (CCF-2020) ontology name for the brain structure from which the tissue sample was taken.

library_aliquot_nhash_id.Description: Unique identifier (NHash ID) of the Library Aliquot associated with this recorded cell.

barcoded_cell_sample_nhash_id.Description: Unique identifier (NHash ID) of the Barcoded Cell Sample associated with this recorded cell.

donor_local_id.Description: LIMS specimen identifier of the donor animal from which this cell was obtained. Corresponds to donor_local_id in participants.tsv.

dandi_file_url.Description: DANDI Archive asset download URL for the NWB data file associated with this session.

nimp_resource_visualizer_url.Description: The URL at the NIMP Analytics Resource Visualizer for the Dissociated Cell Sample associated with this session.

nemo_portal_url.Description: NeMO Archive URL to the portal download page for the FASTQ files associated with this cell.

nemo_assets_url.Description: NeMO Archive URL to the asset landing page for the Library Aliquot associated with this cell.
